card.name: Adverbs like ultimately after and/but
card.fires_on: Sentence adverbs such as "ultimately", "eventually" and "often" placed right after "and", "but" or a verb. They introduce a later outcome or a general tendency.

modes.label: Ultimately/eventually
modes.description: The adverb follows "and" or "but" and leads into a final result or outcome.
modes.example: causing it to disrupt and<< ultimately>> kill cancer cells.

modes.label: Often
modes.description: The adverb "often" appears mid-clause, describing how frequently something occurs.
modes.example: There are<< often>> many legal restrictions relating to sale and supply
